title: INOVIO to Participate in Upcoming Scientific Conferences
summary: INOVIO (NASDAQ:INO), a biotechnology company focused on developing and commercializing DNA medicines tohelp treat and protect people from HPV-associated diseases, cancer and infectious diseases, today announced that it will participate in the following scientific conferences: Eurogin HPV Conference (Vienna, Austria) Date: Thursday, March 19 Time: 8:00 AM CET Presentation : DNA Immunotherapy INO-3107 Demonstrates Long-Term Surgical Intervention Reduction in HPV-6 11 RRP World Vaccine Congress DC (Washington, DC) Date: Monday, March 30 Time: 11:50 AM ET Presentation : Novel DNA-Encoded Monoclonal Antibody Technology: Durable and Tolerable In Vivo Expression of mAbs Targeting COVID Available abstracts will be shared on INOVIOs website following presentations.
